title: MCP server
description: mcp/<code>.yaml: one MCP server, how it is delivered and which tools it offers. A personal secret is written ${secret:NAME}, only in the values of server.env and server.headers, and NAME is defined under secrets in rigdepot.yaml.

server.description: One standard mcpServers entry: the same structure as the JSON filled in when a server is registered on the web.

type.description: stdio: a local process; http: a Streamable HTTP endpoint; sse: an endpoint of the older HTTP with Server-Sent Events transport.

command.description: stdio: the program to start. Pin the version of a package it runs.

env.description: stdio: environment variables for the process. A value may end with a ${secret:NAME}.

headers.description: http and sse: request headers. A value may end with a ${secret:NAME}, such as "Bearer ${secret:JIRA_API_TOKEN}".

delivery.description: native: into the tool's MCP configuration; on-demand: as a skill that calls the server through the command line when it is needed.

tools.description: The server's tools, for the catalogue and for the skill of on-demand delivery, which needs them.
